title: Electrical – Containment & Cabling
activity: Apartment electrical first fix – containment and cabling before close-up
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

location.areaHint: e.g. Riser R2 L03 or Apartment 06.03.02

questions.q: Containment level and neat, brackets at max 1100 mm centres?
Conduits in the partitions in the right locations, draw wires in where needed?
Back boxes fitted level, at the set-out height, nothing missing?
Cables secured with metal clips/bands (no plastic-only fixings), correctly spaced?
Lighting and other drops coiled neatly in position above the ceiling, not lying loose?
Kitchen, bedroom (incl. wardrobe lights and blind boxes) and utility cupboard points all wired?
Controls cabling in: BMS/FCU, MVHR boost/humidistat, UFH floor sensors, KNX, blinds?
Data/TV, fibre and video entry (Cat6) cables in position and coiled?
Fire alarm first-fix cables in with fire-rated (metal) ties?
Main earth run to the mechanical cupboard; sub-main pulled to the electrical cupboard?
Dead test done before the walls and ceilings are closed?
